mapper.sql: id, model_id AS modelId, father_id AS fatherId, name, keywords, description, sort, status
mapper.insert: insert into fly_model_category (model_id, father_id, name, keywords, description, sort, status) values (#{modelId}, #{fatherId}, #{name}, #{keywords}, #{description}, #{sort}, #{status})
mapper.select: select count(*) > 0 from fly_model_category where father_id = #{id}
